### This is simply the best Shower stool!

This my honest opinion after 10 years of daily use. Your experience, and opinion, may vary. I bought my first stool on Amazon, same style, same company. 10 years ago! The page doesn't even exist anymore! This second stool I bought here at Walmart . I needed the support of a shower stool due to difficulty bending over without face planting into the shower floor way back in 2015. I had the old version, which I did buy from Amazon, until this last month, when it finally developed a very small crack, about a half inch to three quarters of an inch, in the center of the seat. I feared that maybe even the heavy duty plastic of the seat was getting stress fatigue from 10 years of daily use. So I began looking around for the same chair. I got this particular shower seat originally because it looked very stable to me. It's mostly a large square, not rectangular. It looked like it had plenty of room to turn and twist, without falling off, and without arm rests or a back rest getting in the way. I really like the freedom of movement I get with this shower stool. I can use my shower brush to get at my back without a back rest getting in the way, or hitting my elbows on arm rests. There isn't anything wrong with armrests, and a back rest if they are needed, but I don't need them. I can sit on this stool and get to my legs, feet, and ankles, without bending and making my self dizzy. Bending is difficult anymore. It's nice and wide both ways, so I don't have to worry about edges cutting into me. It's got a small lip on the very back of the seat so you don't slide off the back. It's got nice drain holes in the top. This one is easier to adjust the height. Just twist the foot of the legs to your the height of liking. ## Carex Universal Bath Seat without Back

## Height-adjustable, tool-free bath seat that fits virtually every tub or shower — supports up to 400 lbs with built-in side handles, drainage holes, and a hand-held shower-spray notch.

The Universal Bath Seat without Back fits into virtually every tub or shower, whether at home or away. It features an innovative design to support up to 400 lbs comfortably. The patented Exact Level height adjustment makes setting the height easy, drainage holes eliminate water pooling, and a convenient notch holds a hand-held shower spray. This bath chair assembles in minutes with no tools required.

 

## Drive Medical Carex Universal Bath Seat Features

Drainage Holes Prevent Pooling

Paired drainage holes across the seat let water run off to help prevent slips, and the wide 18 in (45.72 cm) contoured surface adds seating comfort.

Exact Level Height Adjustment

Rotate the leg tips to raise or lower the seat — counter-clockwise to lower, clockwise to raise — keeping all four legs even across a 16–21 in (40.64–53.34 cm) range.

Built-In Side Handles for Support

Integrated side handles provide added support when sitting down or standing up, adding security to help prevent slips and falls.

Empower Your Independence

Designed for those with balance difficulty or restricted mobility, recuperating from injury or surgery, or anyone who needs added support in the bath.

Non-Slip, 400 lb Capacity

Non-slip height-adjustable tips keep the seat stable, and durable molded plastic supports up to 400 lb (181.44 kg).

Lightweight and Easy to Clean

At just 8.5 lb (3.86 kg), the seat can be easily removed from the shower for cleaning and moved between tubs or showers.

Made in the USA

Built from durable molded plastic with tool-free, removable legs that make it an easy travel bath seat.
